tasks.subject: Task 0: Repo bootstrap
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Working Python project with uv, pytest, mlx-lm; base model downloaded.

**Files:** pyproject.toml, .gitignore, README.md, package __init__.py files

**Verify:** `uv run pytest -q && ls models/base/gemma-4-E2B-it-4bit/*.safetensors | head -1`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["pyproject.toml", ".gitignore", "README.md"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest -q", "acceptanceCriteria": ["uv sync clean", "mlx GPU device", "base model downloaded"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Generator base class + tables generator
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Generator ABC + ls/ps/df table generators (deterministic, ANSI-free).

**Files:** corpus/generators/{base,tables}.py + tests

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/corpus/test_base.py tests/corpus/test_tables.py -v`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["corpus/generators/base.py", "corpus/generators/tables.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest tests/corpus/test_tables.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Generator ABC defined", "ls/ps/df gens deterministic", "no ANSI in output"]}
```
